1.21.1.5.1.1:
- Fixed block breaking speeds
- Fixed Link USB typo
- Oxidized Copper Jammers can now be scraped properly
- All blocks require a stone tool or better now
- Fixed issue where it was possible to turn off the camera when in camera mode.

1.21.4.5.2.0:
- Port from CCTVCraft 5.1.1 to NeoForge 1.21.4.
- Cleaned up the block model paths to make it easier for future porting.

1.21.8.5.3.0:
- Ported from CCTVCraft 5.2.0 to NeoForge 1.21.8
- Updated camera, monitor, and jammer block models and textures.
- Added description to lockpicks.
- Added description to the iron pinlock.
- Added localization for Arabic, Dutch, French, German, Portuguese, and Spanish.
- Bottom half of secure doors now handle permissions when breaking.
- Some blocks now require proper permission ownership/membership to break.
- Fixed some block right-click actions when holding a block.
- Fixed new line description issue in some item tooltips.
1.21.8.5.3.1: - Fixed secure hatch and secure doors not breaking properly when in creative mode.
1.21.8.5.4.0:
- Added Uptime which is unlocked when linking a utility panel to a monitor. 
- Added Music To My Ears which is unlocked when turning on a alarm from the monitor alarm app. 
- Added DJsNDiscs which is unlocked if you open the DiscsNTunez addon monitor app. 
- Added A Turn For The Better, it is unlocked after using a basic screw driver. 
- Added S For Super, it is unclocked after you craft a class S upgrade. 
- Added Alarm and Utility Panel blocks. 
- Added Utility Panel crafting recipe 
- Blocks with ownership now have a NBT logic tag called cctvcraftPrivate. 
- Camera and copper jammer block states have been reworked. 
- Cameras now display a yellow light when they are jammed. 
- Monitor NBT tags have been reworked. 
- Monitors and Cameras now are limited to 1 player use at a time, this will help with settings mismatching between players. 
- Monitor and Camera block tick updates have increased from 1 tick to 20 ticks in length to help with performance a bit. 
- Monitors now store the utility panel's retaliative position as well as position. 
- Utility Panels can support up to 16 USB items. 
- Utility Panels now use upgrades to control how many slots for USBs. 
- Utility Panels supports Link USB and Camera USB items. 
- Added Class C, B, A, and S upgrade chips. 
- Added Alarm USB item. 
- Added Alarm USB crafting recipe. 
- Added Basic Screwdriver and recipe. 
- Alarm USB now can be placed in utility panels. 
- Camera USB now can be placed in utility panels. 
- Camera USB now shows linked data. 
- Link USB now supports alarms and utility panels. 
- Upgrade chips are use to unlock more feature for devices. 
- Updated tooltip for Camera USB description. 
- Added industrial, sci-fi, and siren alarm sounds, attributes can be found on the attributes wiki page. 
- Added a new app for alarms similar to the new camera app. 
- Added a camera logs app screen for owners to log events. 
- Added a camera member app screen for changing camera members remotely. 
- Added desktop app labels for addon/core mod. 
- Added support for colored monitor frames around the ui. 
- Added support for music editor app for the monitor from DiscsNTunes addon mod. 
- The camera app now has a button that can turn the selected camera on/off remotely. 
- The camera app now has a button the owner can use to remotely turn the cameras permission status to private or public. 
- The camera app now has a button to show the last six logged events for the camera. 
- The camera app now has a permissions info page that shows information about, The blocks owner display name, The owners current online status, if the camera is private or public for members, and the current users permission access level eg Owner, Member, Unknown. 
- The camera app can now select cameras from the utility panel. 
- The camera app now has support for camera distance using the Taxicab system between different devices. 
- The camera app now has support for camera information including camera dimension, camera position, and the direction the camera is facing. 
- Updated several icons and buttons for the monitor ui. 
- Updated the monitors desktop, camera and drive screens. 
- Updated the size of the ui for the monitor. 
- Permission system now also stores the owners display name. Will require the device to be re-placed to update variables. 
- Players will now view from the center of the camera lens for each rotation for the simple wall camera. 
- Fixed player placement and rotation for camera view with the simple wall camera. 
- Cameras at times can sometimes be pointed into blocks which can be used to view caves, a fix will take some time to figure out for this.
1.21.8.5.4.1: - Fixed issue where players could view through solid blocks on the left or right of the camera.
